Your Nose and Mouth

Oxford Read and Discover · Level 2 · Your Body · Pages 12–13

🔒 New Words 1 · Listen & Fill 2 · Write 3 · Present 4 · Mind Map

★ New Words

🔒 This part is for the teacher.

Teach these words before the listening task. Press 🔊 to hear the word (American English). Show the picture, read the meaning, then read the example.

breathe

verb

To take air in and out of your body.

“You breathe through your nose and mouth.”

air

noun

What you breathe. You can’t see it.

“Your nose and mouth take air into your body.”

minute

noun

60 seconds.

“You breathe about 15 times every minute.”

fast

adjective

Very quick.

“After exercise, people breathe fast.”

smell

verb

To use your nose to know things.

“Your nose helps you to smell things.”

talk

verb

To say words to someone.

“Your mouth helps you to talk and eat.”

teeth

noun

The hard, white things in your mouth.

“Your teeth bite food.”

bite

verb

To cut food with your teeth.

“Your teeth bite food so you can eat it.”

brush

verb

To clean something with a brush.

“Brush your teeth after breakfast.”

candy

noun

A sweet food. It is bad for your teeth.

“Don’t eat lots of candy.”

2 Write a Summary

Write about your nose and mouth in your own words. Write 15 words or more. Then you can see my example.

💡 Answer these questions

  1. How do you breathe?
  2. What do your nose and mouth take into your body?
  3. What does your nose help you do?
  4. What does your mouth help you do?
  5. What do your teeth do?
  6. How can you protect your teeth?

✏️ Start like this

  • I breathe through …
  • My nose and mouth take …
  • My nose helps me to …
  • My mouth helps me to …
  • My teeth …
  • I brush my teeth …
0 / 15 words

⭐ Example Summary

I breathe through my nose and mouth. They take air into my body. I breathe about 15 times every minute. My nose helps me to smell things. My mouth helps me to talk and eat. My teeth bite food so I can eat it. My body uses food to live and grow. I brush my teeth after breakfast and after dinner, and I don’t eat lots of candy.

3 Presentation Script

Read the script. Practise it. Then present to your class!

Hello!Start

Good morning, everyone! My name is ________. Today I want to talk about my nose and my mouth.

Let’s breathe together. Breathe in… and breathe out!

👉 Breathe in and out slowly with the class.
Part 1Breathe

We breathe through our nose and mouth. Our nose and mouth take air into our body.

We breathe about 15 times every minute.

👉 Point to your nose, then your mouth.
Part 2Fun fact

Here is a fun fact! After exercise, people breathe fast. They can breathe 40 times every minute!

👉 Show the picture. Breathe fast like the man.
Part 3Nose

Our nose helps us to smell things. Mmm… I love the smell of flowers!

👉 Pretend to smell a flower.
Part 4Mouth · Teeth

Our mouth helps us to talk and eat. Our teeth bite food so we can eat it.

Our body uses food to live and grow.

👉 Show the picture. Pretend to bite a watermelon.
Part 5Protect

How can we protect our teeth? We brush our teeth after breakfast and after dinner. And we don’t eat lots of candy!

Question for you: When do you brush your teeth? (Wait for answers.)

👉 Pretend to brush your teeth. Then ask the class.
The EndFinish

Remember: breathe, smell, talk, and eat – our nose and mouth help us every day! Let’s protect our teeth!

Thank you for listening! Do you have any questions?

👉 Smile big and say “Thank you!”

🌟 Presentation Tips

  • Speak slowly and loudly.
  • Look at your friends, not only at the paper.
  • Point to the pictures when you talk.
  • Smile! 😊
